The selected flyer image or timetable is sent to the configured AI service for analysis. After a document is generated, organisation, location, contact, session and website details are sent to the Peer Support Firebase directory as pending services. Email, cost, eligibility, referral, accessibility and additional notes are not sent. API keys are not logged.
